requires.degrade: Without node, detect.mjs cannot run: /user-interface:design reads the project's design files directly and checks routes against the session's own skill listing, as it does when installed is null.

Without the claude CLI on PATH, detect.mjs reports installed as null with a reason, and /user-interface:design checks routes against the session's own skill listing instead of the installed plugin and MCP records.
Without curl, check-good-css-drift.sh cannot read the upstream good-css files and exits 2 (unverifiable); /user-interface:write-css itself does not use it.
